# <img class="hdue-node-icon" src="../icons/HDUE_hdue.svg" alt=""> hdUE Unreal Asset

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Context</dt><dd>LOP node</dd></div><div><dt>Type</dt><dd><code>hdue::hdueunrealasset::1.0</code></dd></div></dl>

Places an asset from a UE project (a Niagara effect, a mesh, a Blueprint, a level) and imports it into hdUE.
{ .hdue-node-summary }

Choose a UE project and one of its assets, then press Import: UE's editor cooks the asset in the background and adds it to the running hdUE runtime, without a restart. The prim is a small box hdUE renders the asset in place of (primvars:unreal:asset). A Niagara System is simulated to the frame rendered from Effect Start Frame. Needs UE's editor (editor_root in .local/paths.json), as hdUE's Substrate materials do.

## Parameters { .hdue-section }

<div class="hdue-params" markdown>

<div class="hdue-param" markdown>
<div class="hdue-param__name">UE Project</div>
<div class="hdue-param__body" markdown>

The UE project (.uproject) the asset comes from. It is not changed: its content is copied into hdUE's UE project to cook.

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Parameter</dt><dd><code>project</code></dd></div></dl>

</div>
</div>

<div class="hdue-param" markdown>
<div class="hdue-param__name">Asset</div>
<div class="hdue-param__body" markdown>

The asset to place, as a cooked object path (/Game/Folder/NS_Fire.NS_Fire): the menu lists the project's levels and the assets named with UE's prefixes (SM_, SK_, BP_, SVT_, NS_).

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Parameter</dt><dd><code>asset</code></dd></div></dl>

</div>
</div>

<div class="hdue-param" markdown>
<div class="hdue-param__name">Import</div>
<div class="hdue-param__body" markdown>

Cooks the asset and what it uses with UE's editor in the background, about a minute for one effect, and adds them to the running hdUE runtime: no restart. An asset the runtime already has needs none.

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Parameter</dt><dd><code>import</code></dd></div></dl>

</div>
</div>

<div class="hdue-param" markdown>
<div class="hdue-param__name">Imported</div>
<div class="hdue-param__body" markdown>

On once the runtime has the asset (Import turns it on): the prim names the asset only then.

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Parameter</dt><dd><code>imported</code></dd></div><div><dt>Default</dt><dd>Off</dd></div></dl>

</div>
</div>

<div class="hdue-param" markdown>
<div class="hdue-param__name">Primitive Path</div>
<div class="hdue-param__body" markdown>

The prim the asset renders on: a small box, which hdUE replaces with the asset.

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Parameter</dt><dd><code>primpath</code></dd></div><div><dt>Default</dt><dd><code>/assets/$OS</code></dd></div></dl>

</div>
</div>

<div class="hdue-param" markdown>
<div class="hdue-param__name">Translate</div>
<div class="hdue-param__body" markdown>

Translate of the prim; the asset keeps UE's size (centimetres) in any stage unit.

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Parameter</dt><dd><code>t</code></dd></div><div><dt>Default</dt><dd>0, 0, 0</dd></div></dl>

</div>
</div>

<div class="hdue-param" markdown>
<div class="hdue-param__name">Rotate</div>
<div class="hdue-param__body" markdown>

Rotate of the prim; the asset keeps UE's size (centimetres) in any stage unit.

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Parameter</dt><dd><code>r</code></dd></div><div><dt>Default</dt><dd>0, 0, 0</dd></div></dl>

</div>
</div>

<div class="hdue-param" markdown>
<div class="hdue-param__name">Scale</div>
<div class="hdue-param__body" markdown>

Scale of the prim; the asset keeps UE's size (centimetres) in any stage unit.

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Parameter</dt><dd><code>s</code></dd></div><div><dt>Default</dt><dd>1, 1, 1</dd></div></dl>

</div>
</div>

<div class="hdue-param" markdown>
<div class="hdue-param__name">Effect Start Frame</div>
<div class="hdue-param__body" markdown>

For a Niagara System: the frame it starts at. hdUE simulates it to the frame rendered, in steps of one frame, as Sequencer plays a Niagara track.

<dl class="hdue-facts"><div><dt>Parameter</dt><dd><code>startframe</code></dd></div><div><dt>Default</dt><dd>1</dd></div></dl>

</div>
</div>
